messages:
Maya Patel: Quick thread to lock social schedule for the Benchmark v2 launch + webinar follow-ups. Webinar Wed May 5 10:00am PT. Need: hero images (LinkedIn + X), 30s promo, 4 X mini-threads, LinkedIn long post, UTMs, and Growth tags for leads.

Sam O'Neill: I can draft all copy. Prefer to avoid posting day-of between 11-1 PT. Also will make short/med/long variants.

Devon Li: Will export two hero sizes as PNG + JPG and drop in /assets/bench_v2/. Also making the 30s clip now.

Maya Patel: Export specs: LinkedIn 1200x627, X 1200x675. Upload both. Tag in #marketing-assets when ready.

Anya Rodriguez: Proposed cadence: teaser 3 days prior, reminder 1hr before, live 10m before, recording + highlights 24h after. I can queue in Sprout once copy + UTMs are final.

Sam O'Neill: UTMs: ?utm_source=social&utm_medium=x_or_linkedin&utm_campaign=bench_v2_launch. Landing: /benchmark?ref=social. I'll pin a canonical X thread after recording.

Devon Li: Uploaded: /assets/bench_v2/hero_1200x627.png, hero_1200x675.png, bench_v2_clip_30s.mp4, bench_v2_preview.gif. Also added bench_v2_onepager.pdf and prompt_examples.pdf.

Maya Patel: Growth tagging needed: benchmark_launch and webinar_reg. @Ezra can you create tags and webhook tests for staging and prod?

Ezra (marketing-bot): Tags and webhook endpoints created. Tags: benchmark_launch, webinar_reg, social_engaged. Staging webhook test returned 200.

Anya Rodriguez: Engagement ops: need 2 responders per channel for first 2 hours. Sam + I cover X; Maya will monitor LinkedIn. I'll add reply templates to the Sprout notes: 1) thanks + recording, 2) stat hook, 3) demo CTA.

Sam O'Neill: Draft plan for X mini-threads: teaser stat + CTA, 4-tweet deep-dive, customer highlight, post-webinar CTAs. Proposed times: Teaser Tue 09:00 PT, Thread Wed 08:00 PT, Reminder Wed 09:00 PT, Recording Thu 10:00 PT.

Maya Patel: Schedule snippet for ops: Teaser Tue 09:00 PT; Thread Wed 08:00 PT; Reminder Wed 09:00 PT; Recording Thu 10:00 PT. Use Sam's UTMs.

Devon Li: Added a short GIF and optimized mp4 to /assets/bench_v2/media.

Anya Rodriguez: I'll queue in Sprout and set responder rotations. Will ping when queued.

Maya Patel: One last ask: collect 3 prompt examples and a one-pager for quick reference in replies. Devon, can you attach to assets zip?

Devon Li: Done. bench_v2_prompts.pdf and bench_v2_onepager.pdf uploaded.

Sam O'Neill: I'll drop the copy variants here by EOD.

Maya Patel: Thanks team. Check-in tomorrow 10:00am PT. If Growth integration or scheduling blocks appear, flag here and @me.
